newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian goods/services in deficit in March.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian goods/services in deficit in March.

text.p: Australia's seasonally adjusted balance on goods and services showed a deficit of A$103 million in March compared to February's surplus of A$315 million (revised from a A$336 million surplus), the Australian Bureau of Statistics said.
This compares with a seasonally adjusted surplus of A$203 million in March 1996.
Economists' median forecast had been for a surplus of around
A$150 million for the balance of goods and services.
EXPORTS: Rural goods 1.858 bln 2.074 bln 1.795 bln
IMPORTS: Consumption goods 1.738 bln 1.872 bln 1.538 bln
Balance of goods/svcs -103 million +315 million +203 million
The Bureau said total exports of goods and services fell seven percent, seasonally adjusted, while imports fell three percent.
Exports of goods alone fell nine percent, while imports fell five percent.
The trend estimate on the balance of goods and services recorded a surplus of A$71 million in March, the 13th consecutive surplus in this balance.
